problem_statement: Build a brand-new /library page from scratch on the Paws SvelteKit site (codexfelis__paws-template__3be3cde37587). The route /library does not exist yet (empty/404 in baseline). Construct a 'Resource Library' page that reuses the site's existing design system (shared Navbar and Footer, colour tokens, Lato/Lora/Playfair fonts) and presents a curated, static list of digital-humanities resources. Each resource card shows a title (h3), a category tag, and a short blurb. Above the list, render a row of tag-filter chips (All, Dataset, Tool, Tutorial, Reading) as <button data-tag=...> controls; clicking a chip narrows the visible list to only the resources carrying that tag (All shows every resource). The shared Navbar and Footer must render identically to the rest of the site (cross-page consistency). The page must be responsive with no horizontal overflow on mobile.
required_content: Tag-filter chip row: buttons All / Dataset / Tool / Tutorial / Reading, each carrying data-tag

Nine resource cards, each an h3 title + category tag + blurb (Old Bailey Online, HathiTrust Corpus, Europeana Newspapers, Voyant Tools, Palladio, Programming Historian, Text Encoding Basics, Distant Reading, Graphs Maps Trees)
Clicking a tag chip filters the visible cards to only that tag (Dataset -> 3 cards)
Shared Navbar (Home / Blog / About links) present, matching sibling pages
Shared Footer (Twitter / GitHub / RSS links) present, matching sibling pages
Mobile layout with no horizontal overflow
design_constraints: Reuse the site design system: colour CSS variables (--colour-main/-bg/-accent/-main-dim), fonts (--font-header Lato, --font-body Lora, --font-fancy Playfair), --border-radius, --space-* spacing

Concrete design tokens to reuse (from the shared theme): page background light blue #ebf5ff (rgb 235,245,255); primary accent / active-chip fill and h1 colour dark slate-blue #2d465d (rgb 45,70,93); body text near-black #141f29 (rgb 20,31,41); card border muted slate #556879 (rgb 85,104,121); border-radius 4px
Typography: the h1 'Resource Library' uses Playfair Display (serif, weight 700, ~48px); filter chips and buttons use Lato (sans-serif); card blurbs and body copy use Lora (serif)

Layout structure: below the shared Navbar render the h1 heading, then the intro paragraph, then a single horizontal row of filter chips, then a vertical stack of resource cards (each card = h3 title + a category tag + a one-line blurb) inside a <ul>/<li> list; active chip is filled with the accent colour, inactive chips are outlined
Reuse the shared $lib/Navbar.svelte and $lib/Footer.svelte via the root __layout.svelte (do not fork the chrome)
Static self-contained data (no network fetch) so the page renders deterministically
author_notes: Plan A: baseline lacks /library (empty stub + chrome stripped from baseline root __layout so the missing route is genuinely empty under adapter-static SSG); reference fully implements the page with a working tag-filter; bad copies reference but drops the chip on:click handler so the filter never narrows the list (interaction_assertions fails; all other gates still pass). Three source workspaces are md5-distinct. T3 consistency encoded as dom_assertions binding shared Navbar (Home/Blog links) + Footer (GitHub/RSS) on BOTH desktop_library AND sibling desktop_about, with footer-consistency also on mobile_library + mobile_about (nav collapses to hamburger at 390px, gotcha #18am).
